reviews.title: Pushy. Very hard to cancel. Food is ok but they sometimes deliver to my suite and other times leave
reviews.text:
I tried this service. Food was fine . But the delivery is all over the map. Sometimes at my door and sometimes in the building lobby. Handy since i never go there. So a soggy box full of melted ice from a leaky bag. With fish. 
No thanks

reviews.title: Not What We Ordered
reviews.text: We were very disappointed to find the meals we received on our very first order were not what we ordered. Tiny portions, complete disappointment.

reviews.title: Frais cachés et repas long
reviews.text: Très déçu. Frais cachés et élevés, repas long à préparer et ils envoies des boites repas que je n'ai pas choisi et pas apprécié.

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: This app interface is absolutely unlike the web interface, and not in a good way. It is complicated and freezes and is difficult to navigate.  Now app will not allow me to login either. Deleted. I will just use my web browser to interact with chefs plate. Why have an app if it doesn’t make things easier, or even work for a start?

reviews.title: Can’t edit meals
reviews.text: Key feature either doesn’t work on the app - can’t edit meals.

reviews.title: Scammer
reviews.text: I used their service for a few weeks then decided to stop. Then they started calling me EVERYDAY, from different numbers! They even call me super late at night. Horrible experience and i feel harassed at this point. I do NOT recommend affiliate with this company. scammer vibe

reviews.title: Une belle gang d'HARCELEUR.
reviews.text: Il ne te lache pas. Textos, appels (je les aient bloqués) et maintenant par lettre. CRISS LACHER MOI OU VOUS ALLEZ RECEVOIR UNE MISE EN DEMEURE SOUS PEU. juste pour votre info, c'est illégal d'harceler une personne.

reviews.title: Complete Scam
reviews.text: They will still charge you even if you cancel the subscription or even delete the account. Had a really bad experience with them. Definitely wouldn’t recommend.

reviews.title: New App BAD
reviews.text:
The new app is difficult to use, go back to simple.
I should not have to google where to find skip week button. It should be simple.

reviews.title: Awful food and service
reviews.text: The level of incompetence and rudeness from their customer service team is of another level, the entire order was a disaster, everything was wrong, they double up on the order, billing is a nightmare. Tried it one and NEVER again

reviews.title: No updates, poor communication
reviews.text:
Reaching out to customer service for an unexpected charge on my account. They were incredibly unhelpful. The app is not easy to use, communication is not clear and the updates or notifications on what’s being ordered is non existent. The app shows, no details on my order, no subscription information and no order / account charges. I discouraging anyone from using this app
Or service, Hello Fresh is much better and easier to use.

reviews.title: Scam!!!
reviews.text: Attention!!!! They take money without any “scheduled delivery/ meal plan” I made an account and ordered one time then cancelled everything… deleted account removed payment methods etc. account should have been gone then 3 months later was charged 110 dollars for food I did not order.

reviews.title: Unacceptable
reviews.text: They postpone my delivery 2 times in the same day, I contacted the support and they told me that my delivery would be the next day without offering any good reason or anything to make up for their mistake . The support was of no help whatsoever. The food is mostly carbs with really little protein and it’s not really fresh if you compare to other food services.

reviews.title: App intentionally limits functionality to maximize their profits
reviews.text: It specifically says that you are able to skip six weeks worth of orders, but through the app you’re limited to only three or four weeks. On top of that, you were unable to see any credits and how they are being applied from mess ups on their orders to you. As well, or change your subscription through the app. But must do through, when you’ve done everything through the app
